references.text: Isaac asks Esau to hunt game and prepare food for him so that he may bless him before his death – the words Rebekah reports in verse 7.
Isaac loved Esau because he ate of his game, which explains why Isaac requests game as part of the blessing.
Jacob deceives Isaac by pretending to be Esau and receives the blessing with the food Rebekah prepared.
Esau brings his dish to Isaac to be blessed but discovers that Jacob has already received the blessing.
Esau bears a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing their father gave him.
This verse is the immediate narrative continuation of the source verse's request and shows how Esau tried to meet his father's demand.
This verse describes the actual fulfillment of Isaac's original request for food to trigger the blessing.
